main_body: East-facing wooden pew with three red seat cushions
top_band: Red and brown horizontal seat surface seen from above (rows 14 to 57) and backrest top (rows 9 to 56)
evidence: This is an east-facing pew oriented vertically (north-south). The horizontal seat surface (rows 14-57, with three red cushions) and the top of the backrest (rows 9-56) are clearly seen from above, and the south-facing side/front base of the pew is visible at the bottom (rows 57-61, with a front edge highlight at row 58 and vertical support shading below).

style.evidence: The pew uses large flat fills of a single red tone (5x11 pixels per cushion with no internal shading or texture) and long uniform vertical strips of flat brown for the wood. Shading steps per material are only 2-3 (flat red + one dark shadow line; 3-4 flat brown bands with no wood grain), making it much flatter and less dense than the Beodeul references.
